findings.detail: The dl_rate_fill warning counts blank rates on unfunded direct-lending commitments even where the source SOI itself prints dashes in the Reference, Spread, and Interest Rate columns.

rationale: Class 3 CIK-quarter fill-rate warning. The raw SOI source is readable. Funded AAH Topco rows carry coupon data in the Interest Rate column, while the sampled AAH Topco undrawn rows in the unfunded-debt section print dashes for Reference, Spread, and Interest Rate. The extracted blank rate for those undrawn direct-lending rows therefore matches source rather than proving a missing extraction. The aggregate warning is a rule-scope false alarm because it treats source-blank unfunded commitments as rate-fill violations.
